description: Singapore CPF contributions from 1 January 2026 for monthly wages above $750: employer and employee rates by age (55 and below 17% + 20%, above 55 to 60 16% + 18%, above 60 to 65 12.5% + 12.5%, above 65 to 70 9% + 7.5%, above 70 7.5% + 5%), Ordinary Wage ceiling $8,000. Not rounded; bonuses and low-wage rates are not computed. Singapore (CPF Board), as of 2026-11-22. General information only: not tax or legal advice.
